slides.title: GODOT Card Game Project
slides.description: For the Summer holiday, I attempted to make a functioning card game UI via the GODOT game engine

slides.title: What makes [Superhero] Cinematic Universes Successful?
slides.description: My article for Reelhouse Issue 4. In this article, I delve into what makes most superhero cinematic universes (MCU, DCU, etc.) so successful, especially within individual superhero movies.

slides.title: What would be the worst place to survive in? Zombie Apocalypse vs. Robot Uprising
slides.description: In my article for Reelhouse Issue 5, I aim to solve a question the greatest film philosophers in history have pondered, and could not solve! Which would be harder to survive - robot uprising or zombie outbreak?

slides.title: Reelhouse Issue 6 Article
slides.description: My article for Reelhouse Issue 6 tries to explore why the concept of 4th instalments are so disliked by most audiences despite being a sequel to their favourite series.

slides.title: Brawl-Out Revamp
slides.description: A revamped rendition of my first terminal-based game done in Python. BRAWL-OUT is a text-based multiplayer card game where players aim to be the last one standing by using various weapons, effects, and more to reduce their health to 0.

slides.title: C File-System
slides.description: A terminal-based file system done fully in the C programming language

slides.title: JUMPER MAN
slides.description: Pygame assignment for my time at West Herts College. This involves controlling a character to jump on trampolines to get the most points possible.
